snippet.title: Touched by an Outer God - Trailer
snippet.description:
Touched by an Outer God is an action-horror FPS game where you kill monsters and eat their flesh to grow stronger. This was made as part of the Dread X Collection Volume 2 and was created by Wither Studios.

Follow us: https://twitter.com/WitherStudios
